Independently invent a cautious near-ground landscape on Oberon, Uranus moon: old cratered grey ice-rich-looking regolith with low rounded crater rims, scattered angular blocks, a few brighter patches and a distant modest ridge. New imagined terrain, not any named Voyager crater or registered globe site. Never imitate or reuse Moon, Callisto, Mars or another observed body geography. Text verbatim large top-left "OBERON · IMAGINED"; bottom-left "Invented terrain · no registered site". No coordinates, scale bars or additional labels.
